decision_summary: Retrospective: v0.6.29 converted false precision into an explicit governed uncertainty record without pretending a simple observed range is statistical certainty.
rationale: Visionary: the slice advanced empirical calibration readiness while staying domain-general. Builder: one canonical record and deterministic arithmetic kept the release narrow and reproducible. Guardian: separating observed range from confidence interval prevented overclaiming; the remaining readiness blocker is evidence that calibration findings actually changed the framework.
recommendation: Make v0.6.30 Framework Learning Records the next slice, linking contradicted assumptions and calibration evidence to governed framework changes.
